title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points for the second straight week
items.desc: The Steelers' D/ST allowed 27 points on 372 yards of total offense, recording five sacks and forcing two turnovers in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
items.impact: The Steelers' defense made plenty of big plays in Thursday's loss. The unit also gave up a few too many big plays. The Steelers have allowed division rivals to put up exactly 27 points in back-to-back weeks. There's no doubting the Pittsburgh pass rush, but as a whole, the defense has been showing some holes. The Colts are next up.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Chris Boswell accounts for four points in Thursday's loss
items.desc: Chris Boswell made 1-of-2 field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
items.impact: Boswell made a field goal from 31 yards and missed another from 48 yards Thursday night. With the Steelers trying a pair of two-point conversions during a fourth-quarter comeback, the veteran kicker attempted only one PAT on the night. Through four games, Boswell is 7-of-10 on FG attempts and has made all six of his PATs. He's a middle-of-the-road fantasy option at the moment.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Browns defense comes up with two picks in Thursday's win
items.desc: The Browns" D/ST gave up 24 points on 361 yards of total offense, coming up with two sacks and two interceptions in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Steelers.
items.impact: The Browns largely shut the Steelers' offense down through the first three quarters Thursday night, allowing just 10 points. The Steelers rallied for a fourth-quarter comeback behind QB Aaron Rodgers before Browns kicker Andre Szmyt nailed a 56-yard, game-winning field goal with 10 seconds remaining. Still, the Browns defense turned in a fairly solid effort, and the unit has played well during a surprising three-game winning streak. An inviting matchup with the Jets awaits in Week 5.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Andre Szmyt puts nine points on the board in Thursday's win
items.desc: Andre Szmyt made both of his field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Browns.
items.impact: The Browns won three straight games, and suddenly Szmyt looks like a very useful fantasy option. The second-year pro hit a career-long 56-yard FG with 10 seconds left to win Thursday's contest, and he's been perfect on eight three-point attempts and seven PATs so far this season.

items.title: Mason Graham (knee) ruled out for remainder of TNF
items.desc: Mason Graham (knee) ruled out for the rest of the Browns game against the Steelers on Thursday.
items.impact: Graham went down early in the contest after an awkward slip and getting pinned down. He limped gingerly off the field and was taken back to the locker room and ruled out shortly after half time.

items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not expected to play Week 4

Fantasy managers should find someone else to start in place of the injured veteran.
